verdict.summary: You can build this integration. To let customers connect their own business data, you need Business Verification and App Review for the needed permissions. Record each permission flow and give reviewers clear test instructions.
verdict.activeEffort: 2–4 days, mostly building a testable flow and preparing review evidence (estimate)
verdict.waitTime: A few days to several weeks (official)
verdict.mainGate: The app must be connected to a business that completed Business Verification before it can request Advanced Access permissions or let other businesses access their own data. Multi-customer ad permissions also need App Review.

recommendation.text: Create a Business app and use Facebook Login for Business. Use a separate configuration for each customer group when needed. Request a business integration system-user token for automated customer ad actions.

sources.quote: The Business app type is for apps that help businesses, creators, and organizations manage their presence and advertise on Meta's Social Technologies apps.

Facebook Login for Business is the preferred authentication and authorization solution for tech providers building integrations with Meta's business tools to create marketing, messaging, and selling solutions.
Business integration system user access tokens should be used if your app performs programmatic, automated actions on your business clients' assets

scopeTiers.text: Read ad reports only. This is the cheapest Marketing API read-only tier.

sources.quote: The ads_read permission allows your app to access the Ads Insights API to pull Ads report information
If your app is managing other people's ad accounts, you need advanced access to the `ads_read` and/or `ads_management` permissions.

scopeTiers.text: Create or change campaigns. This needs Advanced Access, Meta's permission review, for customer accounts.

sources.quote: The ads_management permission allows your app to both read and manage the Ads account it owns, or has been granted access to
If your app is managing other people's ad accounts, you need advanced access to the `ads_read` and/or `ads_management` permissions.

scopeTiers.need: Create, pause, or edit ads and campaigns for each customer.

scopeTiers.text: Manage business assets or system-user tokens. This adds a broader business permission and review justification.

sources.quote: The business_management permission allows your app to read and write with the Business Manager API.
The system user must be added to your app
`business_management`
`ads_management`

scopeTiers.need: Manage business assets or create and manage system-user tokens.

scopeTiers.text: Retrieve ad leads. This adds a permission that must be separately justified in review.

sources.quote: `leads_retrieval` | Required for Capture & manage ad leads.

scopeTiers.need: Read leads submitted through customer ad forms.

essentials.text: Exchange codes on your server. Default user and Page tokens expire in hours. Exchange them before expiry for a token lasting about 60 days. Expired tokens require login again. For automated customer actions, use a customer-authorized business system-user token, which normally never expires.

sources.quote: Default User and Page access tokens are short-lived, expiring in hours
A long-lived token generally lasts about 60 days.
You can not use an expired token to request a long-lived token. If the token has expired, your app must send the user through the login flow again
Defaults to never expire for the common offline server-to-server communication.

essentials.text: Add every callback URL in Client OAuth Settings. Send exactly the same redirect URI during login and code exchange.

sources.quote: Verify the Valid OAuth redirect URIs in the Client OAuth Settings section.
`redirect_uri`. This argument is required and must be the same as the original `request_uri` that you used when starting the OAuth login process.

essentials.text: Use a sandbox ad account for test ad creation and reports. It has no charges, needs no payment method, and does not deliver ads. An unverified business account may hold developer or administrator roles on at most 15 unconnected apps.

sources.quote: Sandbox ad accounts allow testing without charges, do not require a payment method, and do not deliver ads.
You are permitted to have a developer or administrator role on a maximum of 15 apps that are not already connected to a Meta Verified Business Account.

essentials.text: Limited Access has a maximum score of 60. Full Access has a maximum score of 9000. Reads use one point and writes use three points. Write calls are limited to 100 requests per second for each app and ad-account pair. The same object defaults to one edit every 30 seconds.

sources.quote: Generally speaking, a read API call is equal to 1 point, and a write API call is equal to 3 points
maximum score is 60
maximum score is 9000.
Limit: 100 requests per second (QPS) per app and ad account combination.
one edit per object every 30 seconds.

essentials.text: Use a sandbox ad account for no-charge API testing. It does not require a payment method and does not deliver ads.

sources.quote: Sandbox ad accounts allow testing without charges, do not require a payment method, and do not deliver ads.

essentials.text: Add the Marketing API product. Limited Access is automatic but is for development only. Move to Full Access for live advertiser workloads after meeting Meta's call volume and error-rate requirements.

sources.quote: Automatically granted when you add the Marketing API product to your app.
Heavily rate-limited per ad account. For development only. Not for production apps running for live advertisers.
Your app needs 500+ Marketing API calls in the past 15 days and an error rate below 15% for the last 500 calls.

essentials.text: Finish the app before submission. Make a successful call with every requested permission within 30 days. Give separate explanations, a screen recording, and reviewer steps for every permission. Add a 1024x1024 app icon, privacy policy URL, purpose, category, and primary contact.

sources.quote: Make sure you have completed app development and that it is ready for us to test.
Make at least 1 successful API call using each permission for which you are requesting advanced access. Calls must be made within 30 days of submitting for App Review
Any requested permission or feature missing a screen recording will not be approved.
Upload a 1024x1024 compliant app icon image to Settings > Basic > App Icon.

essentials.text: Encrypt stored customer tokens with standard encryption and managed keys. Log access to user data and where it was sent or stored. Keep read-only connections separate from write-capable connections. Require customer confirmation before ad changes.

sources.quote: Use standard encryption; don’t roll your own or rely on data encoding or obfuscation
Use key management systems when available
Have a system in place for logging access to user data, tracing where user data was sent and stored
Don't grant permissions that can make changes to AI agents that process untrusted input.

detail.text: Register as a developer, then open Meta's App Creation flow. Meta requires a developer account before you can create an app.

sources.quote: To create an app with Meta, you must first register as a developer and be logged into your developer account.
Navigate to https://developers.facebook.com/apps/creation/ to begin the app creation process.

steps.title: Create a Business app

detail.text: Create a Business app in the App Creation flow. Enter the app name and contact email. Choose carefully because Meta does not allow app type changes.

sources.quote: Enter your app's name and a contact email address.
App types cannot be changed.

steps.output: A Business app with its name and contact email.

steps.title: Add required products

detail.text: Add Facebook Login for Business and the Marketing API product in the app dashboard. Limited Marketing API access is granted when you add the product.

sources.quote: Automatically granted when you add the Marketing API product to your app.

Facebook Login for Business is the preferred authentication and authorization solution for tech providers building integrations with Meta's business tools to create marketing, messaging, and selling solutions.

steps.output: Facebook Login for Business and Marketing API are added.

steps.title: Allowlist callback URLs

detail.text: Add exact callback URLs under Client OAuth Settings. Use the same URL during authorization and the code exchange.

sources.quote: Verify the Valid OAuth redirect URIs in the Client OAuth Settings section.
`redirect_uri`. This argument is required and must be the same as the original `request_uri` that you used when starting the OAuth login process.

steps.output: Production and test callback URLs in Client OAuth Settings.

steps.title: Draft secure callback handler

detail.text: Use a session-bound state value and PKCE, a proof that binds the login to your app. Exchange the code on your server. Store the returned customer token encrypted after verifying its identity and customer mapping.

sources.quote: used to prevent Cross-site Request Forgery.
Facebook Login supports the OpenID Connect (OIDC) standard's Authorization Code flow with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE)
The call will need to be server-to-server, since it involves your app secret.
Never include this app secret in client-side code or in binaries that could be decompiled.

steps.title: Configure customer token access

detail.text: Create a Facebook Login for Business configuration for automated customer ad work. For programmatic actions, use a customer-authorized business integration system-user token. Login requests for this token work only on web surfaces. Each customer needs a business portfolio, and your business portfolio must be separate from theirs.

sources.quote: You can create multiple configurations and present them to different sets of users.
Associated with your business client's business portfolio rather than a specific user.
This needs to be separate from the business portfolio owned by your business client.

steps.output: A Login for Business configuration using customer-authorized business system-user tokens.

steps.title: Test with sandbox ads

detail.text: Create or use a sandbox ad account. Test each requested permission with successful API calls. Do this before review because each call must be recent.

sources.quote: A sandbox ad account lets you test ad creation and reporting using the Facebook Marketing API without incurring charges.
Make at least 1 successful API call using each permission for which you are requesting advanced access. Calls must be made within 30 days of submitting for App Review

steps.output: Successful report and ad mutation calls against a sandbox ad account.

steps.title: Add customer approval gates

detail.text: Require customer confirmation before any publish, budget, audience, or campaign change. Keep report-only connections separate from connections that can change ads.

sources.quote: An AI agent can directly call anything your granted permissions allow, without asking you first
Don't grant permissions that can make changes to AI agents that process untrusted input.

steps.output: A confirmation screen before publishing, budget, audience, or campaign changes.

steps.title: Verify the business

detail.text: Connect the app to your business, then start verification at Settings > Basic > Verification. A business administrator must complete this step. It applies before Advanced Access and customer-owned data access.

sources.quote: Apps that request advanced access for permissions and apps that allow other Businesses to access their own data must be connected to a Business that has completed Business Verification.
go to Settings > Basic > Verification and click the Start Verification button
only someone with an Admin role in the Business will be able to complete the verification process.

steps.output: A Business Verification submission with required documents.

steps.title: Prepare review materials

detail.text: Prepare separate permission explanations, reviewer instructions, and a screen-recording storyboard. Do not give personal account credentials. Meta tests with its own test accounts.

sources.quote: Any requested permission or feature missing a screen recording will not be approved.
We will test your app using our own test accounts. Do not include your _personal_ Meta Technologies app account's credentials.

steps.output: Review script: 1. Open Connect Meta. 2. Sign in with Meta's reviewer test account. 3. Select one test ad account. 4. Open Reports to show ads_read data. 5. Open Draft campaign. 6. Change a field and show the confirmation screen. 7. Confirm the change. Record these steps once for each requested permission.

steps.title: Submit Advanced Access request

detail.text: Submit Advanced Access requests for only the needed permissions. Include a public app or clear test access instructions. Add the required app icon and disclosure settings before submission.

sources.quote: Selecting unneeded permissions is a common reason for rejection during app review.
Your app must be publicly available or you must provide instructions on how to access it.
Upload a 1024x1024 compliant app icon image to Settings > Basic > App Icon.

steps.output: An App Review submission for only the required permissions.

steps.title: Wait for review decisions

detail.text: Wait for business verification and permission review. Business verification depends on document quality. Permission review may take several weeks.

sources.quote: Business verification should take a few days, however it will depend on the quality of documentation.
Permission review may take up to several weeks.

steps.effort: wait: a few days to several weeks
steps.output: Business Verification and App Review decisions.

steps.title: Request Full Access

detail.text: Request a Full Access upgrade through App Review when the app needs live advertiser scale. First meet Meta's recent API performance requirements: at least 500 Marketing API calls in the past 15 days and an error rate below 15% for the last 500 calls. This applies after Limited Access development usage.

sources.quote: These requirements also apply to upgrading your Marketing API Access Tier from Limited access to Full access.
Your app needs 500+ Marketing API calls in the past 15 days and an error rate below 15% for the last 500 calls.

steps.output: A Full Access upgrade request after the required recent API performance.

steps.title: Encrypt and audit tokens

detail.text: Encrypt every stored customer token with managed keys. Log token and data access. Prevent a token from one customer business from accessing another customer's assets.

sources.quote: Use key management systems when available
Have a system in place for logging access to user data, tracing where user data was sent and stored
not shareable and accessible across different client businesses.

steps.output: Encrypted token storage, access logs, and customer-specific access controls.

gotchas.text: Choose the Business app type at creation. Meta does not allow changing the app type later.

sources.quote: App types cannot be changed.

gotchas.text: Meta renamed access tiers. Older screens may say Standard or Advanced, while newer screens say Limited or Full.

sources.quote: Tier labels have been updated: "Standard Access" is now Limited Access, and "Advanced Access" is now Full Access.

gotchas.text: Business system-user login requests work only from web surfaces. They also require a business portfolio and separate provider and customer portfolios.

sources.quote: Your app can only request logins from web surfaces
This needs to be separate from the business portfolio owned by your business client.

gotchas.text: If you use Meta generative ad features, extra terms apply. A human must preview AI-generated creative before publication.

sources.quote: If you use Marketing API to access our Generative AI features outlined below, the Ad Creative Generative AI Terms apply in addition to the Meta Platform Terms.
Advertisers are responsible for previewing ad creative featuring AI-generated creatives before publishing their ads.

whenBlocked.text: If business verification stalls, ask the business administrator to check documents and restart verification in Settings > Basic > Verification.

sources.quote: Refer to our Business Manager Help Center's About Business Verification topic for an explanation of the process and a list of documents you will need.
only someone with an Admin role in the Business will be able to complete the verification process.

whenBlocked.text: If App Review rejects a permission, fix the stated issue, then comment in the dashboard or resubmit the permission review.

sources.quote: Once fixed, you can submit a comment on your app dashboard, or if your appeal is regarding a permission request review, you can resubmit your app review.

whenBlocked.text: If documentation or dashboard behavior is unclear, use Ask a question or Contact Direct Support.

sources.quote: Ask a question
Contact Direct Support,
Once submitted, Developer Support will get back to you within 2 business days.

uncertain: App Review timing conflicts in official sources. One page says a decision should arrive within a week. Another says permission review may take several weeks.
No source gives a standalone Meta developer subscription or Marketing API access price.
3 claims couldn't be matched word-for-word to their cited page and are marked Unverified. Check those sources before relying on them.
